title: International Chemistry Tournament 2025 official marking scheme

criteria.name: Solution model
subcriteria: No task parts omitted to simplify the problem

criteria.name: Scientific correctness and completeness
subcriteria: Scientific correctness of solution parts and answers

criteria.name: Originality
subcriteria: Clear citation and distinction of literature from original contribution

criteria.name: Presentation
subcriteria: Balance of images, data, and text
Organization and visibility of key points

criteria.name: Debate skills
subcriteria: Relevance and scientific basis of arguments

criteria.name: Relevance
subcriteria: Relevant errors and missing details raised

technical_point_calculation.discarding: For each grade set, discard the highest and lowest jury grades.
technical_point_calculation.aggregation: Convert remaining grades to TPs, average them, and round to two decimal places.

rating_point_calculation.delta_first: Difference between the team's TP and the first-ranked team's TP; zero for first place.
rating_point_calculation.delta_second: Difference between the team's TP and the second-ranked team's TP; zero for first and second place.

applicability.benchmark_coverage: The local IChTo benchmark contains open-ended problem sets from multiple editions; this scoring file applies only where 2025 rules govern.
applicability.other_editions: Do not apply this conversion, RP formula, or criteria to another edition without that edition's official rule book.

supports: oral report plus opposition/review task format

limitations: A complete score requires multiple jury grades and the other teams' stage TPs; a submitted written solution alone cannot produce official RPs.
The official grade is based on the nine subcriteria for each role component, not on independently weighted point dimensions.
PDF extraction artifacts were normalized only where the rule text and grading-sheet labels were clear.
